desc:
Blog post drafts edited by a person give your business useful articles without the blank page. Ecom Swift LLC drafts each post from an outline you approve, edits it to sound human, flags every claim to check and delivers text ready to publish.

## What are edited blog and article drafts?

Edited blog drafts are articles that start with fast research and drafting tools and finish with a person reading every line. The person removes filler, fixes the tone, checks the structure and marks any statement that needs your confirmation. You receive text that sounds like your business, not text that sounds like a template.

The draft is yours to change. We deliver a title, headings and body copy, and you decide when and where it goes live.

## Why helpful articles matter for a business

A blog gives search engines and answer engines something to quote, and it gives buyers a reason to trust you before they spend. A customer who reads a clear guide on choosing a product arrives at the product page better informed. A post that answers a common question can also bring people to the site who never searched for your brand by name.

The effect is slow and depends on topic choice, competition and how often you publish. Still, a site with useful, accurate articles has more ways to be found than a site with only product pages. The risk is publishing weak content: pages that repeat each other, invent facts or read as if no one cared. That is why editing and fact flags matter as much as the writing.

## What a good article draft includes

- A title that says plainly what the reader will learn.
- A short opening that answers the main question before it explains.
- Headings written the way people phrase real questions.
- Short paragraphs and bullet lists where a list is easier to scan.
- Your tone, kept consistent from the first line to the last.
- Specific examples, in place of vague claims about quality.
- Names, numbers and claims marked for you to confirm before publishing.
- Internal link ideas that connect the post to your products and other articles.
- A meta title and meta description written for search results.
- Descriptive image alt text for the pictures you plan to use.

## How we work

We begin with an outline. You tell us the topic, the reader and the goal, and we send a simple structure for approval, so no one wastes time on a draft that goes the wrong way. After approval we write the draft, edit it by hand and mark anything that could be wrong, such as dates, product specifications or legal and health statements.

The Basic package delivers a pair of edited drafts. Standard adds more drafts, internal link suggestions, meta text and a round of tone matching against your existing writing. Premium adds a topic plan for the coming months, a short style sheet for future posts, drafts uploaded to your site as unpublished pages and alt text for the images.

We do not invent quotes, sources or customer stories. If we cannot support a statement, we leave it out or flag it.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Pick topics that match real questions your customers ask.
- Read the flagged claims and confirm each one before you publish.
- Add a photo or detail only you can supply, such as a workshop picture.
- Link new posts to the products they discuss.
- Refresh older articles when your product or prices change.

**Avoid:**
- Publishing a draft without reading it once yourself.
- Stuffing a post with search words until it sounds unnatural.
- Writing many posts on the same question with slightly different titles.
- Making medical, financial or legal claims you cannot support.
- Posting at full speed for a month and then going silent.

## Who these drafts are for

This service suits a shop owner who knows customers have questions but has no time to write the answers. It suits a consultant or local business that wants a steady library of useful pages. It also suits an editor or marketing lead who needs strong first drafts to polish, rather than starting every piece from nothing.

## What we need from you

Share your website address, a few existing pages that show your tone, your topics or questions, and any facts we must respect. If your site needs uploading, we ask for a collaborator or staff role with limited permissions, never a password. You approve each outline and keep control of publishing.
